policy: Official source links may be accepted for ordinary reference use within the exact identity, date, and scope recorded. Link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic coverage, dependencies, currentness, and country completion. Gesetze im Internet consolidations are working references; the electronic Bundesgesetzblatt is the authentic promulgation source for specific discrepancy, commencement, or amendment checks.
